content: O̠ku̠a a̠d̠ighi be̠le̠ni̠, akpe̠ i̠yar o̠mar o̠nagha i̠di̠ar ya̠ i̠yar na̠ o̠mu̠gho̠n bho̠, b̠o̠ka̠ i̠yar umel o̠d̠u̠a.

Ezin bho̠ a̠duom wa̠ itileduom ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ bho̠ i̠gba imutiom bho̠ ya̠gia̠ga̠i, sa̠ na̠ osobh ase̠ ya̠ igielake̠ na̠ ogboloma̠ ma̠ eb̠la̠ ogbo ya̠ na̠ e̠pi̠o̠gho̠m bho̠, na̠ iya̠ o̠nagha d̠o̠ ma̠ o̠nu̠o̠kpe̠ bho̠.

I̠yar ta̠ od̠ighi eka̠ omiza̠n ku̠gba ma̠ i̠yar oghel obom ogir itenemeni ola̠ o̠ku̠a? Wa̠nwuna̠ bho̠ na̠ agu̠o̠ a̠d̠ia̠ agba ma̠ ogir itenemeni onon a̠mutiom, sa̠ ogbo ya̠ i̠mu̠gho̠n bho̠ ibhin ra̠ i̠gba inigha̠ i̠yar ma̠ iya̠gia̠ga̠i.
Sa̠ A̠zib̠a̠ a̠bhin relegh, na̠ ilologia̠n na̠ a̠d̠ien kere kere ogir ilologia̠n, na̠ atu̠gi̠ re̠ne̠ghe̠ E̠mu̠gh E̠tu̠tu̠ bho̠, a̠muzoghod̠iom asu̠gbagba d̠awa d̠a̠ i̠to̠ d̠o̠yo̠.
I̠na na̠ onigha̠ d̠o̠ ma̠ itileduom ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ bho̠ ma̠ orileghom e̠ma ra̠ a̠nwunom, wa̠ i̠yar na̠ o̠gba na̠ ogboloma̠ bho̠.
Kpe̠le̠me̠ni̠, u̠gba ma̠ odi esi d̠a̠ ra̠d̠ire e̠tu̠tu̠ bho̠ ma̠a̠,

content.text: “ ‘O̠nyi̠o̠mo̠ro̠ni̠ ka̠ ere ma̠ ola̠ anwa na̠ aru̠ru̠an na̠ a̠gboloma̠, bo̠d̠o̠ ka̠ i̠na o̠nyi̠ ta̠ o̠ni̠ ke̠re̠ ma̠ ola̠ anwa na̠ a̠kponom’?
Anwa i̠le̠m i̠na aki̠ri̠me̠ni̠ ma̠ i̠ki̠ki̠ra a̠pu ma̠ itileduom ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠, sa̠ anwa ibhin eghoi isosorogia̠n na̠ edim izuom i̠na,
iguri ma̠ eb̠la̠ i̠di̠ar d̠a̠ ekpukpu a̠sike d̠o̠yo̠ ma̠ orileghom.’ ”

content: U̠ge̠ ma̠a̠, ‘eb̠la̠ i̠di̠ar,’ o̠ku̠a na̠ a̠ma̠ra̠ ma̠a̠ abar ola̠ usigimeni bo̠. Ya̠a̠, i̠yar ta̠ o̠bi̠gh d̠o̠ ka̠ o̠nyi̠o̠mo̠ro̠ni̠ na̠ orileghom eb̠la̠ i̠di̠ar i̠se̠n.

Ya̠a̠ i̠yar na̠ o̠bi̠gh A̠zizo̠s wa, ekud̠i obhel sa̠ uguri ma̠ a̠dila̠de ola̠ aki̠r a̠pu ma̠ ita̠ itileduom ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ bho̠, b̠o̠ka̠ d̠a̠ igbirigbir ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ i̠na a̠gbika̠ a̠mugh ebula̠ i̠yar. I̠se̠n i̠yar na̠ o̠bi̠gh ka̠ na̠ ozuom i̠na ma̠ eghoi isosorogia̠n na̠ edim, d̠a̠ ebula̠ egbika̠ omugh d̠o̠yo̠.

A̠zib̠a̠ wa̠ ale̠m eb̠la̠ i̠di̠ar bho̠, ato̠ ma̠ obhin a̠d̠izo anwi̠i̠ny od̠ighom d̠a̠ isosorogia̠n d̠o̠yo̠. Sa̠ a̠bhon agu̠o̠ i̠na ab̠ab̠alame̠ni̠ ma̠ A̠zizo̠s amado̠n bho̠, d̠a̠ ebula̠ egbika̠ ya̠ A̠zizo̠s atu̠n otenemeni awa a̠gbika̠ d̠a̠ omugh bho̠.

O̠ku̠a bha̠ i̠se̠n, A̠zizo̠s na̠ ogbo ya̠ i̠na na̠ ab̠ab̠alame̠ni̠ a̠nigha̠ ma̠ A̠zib̠a bho̠, na̠ eten anwi̠i̠ny onin eghun. Obha̠ ezin bho̠ i̠na od̠igh d̠o̠ ma̠ ari̠ghe̠l obhelegi awa ma̠ a̠rumor na̠ aru̠marani̠ d̠o̠yo̠.
Ezin bho̠ i̠na agba a̠nigha̠ ma̠ A̠zib̠a̠ ma̠a̠,

content.text: “Ami̠ ta̠ a̠sen ib̠eb̠i ya̠ d̠a̠ a̠d̠ien d̠oyom bho̠ a̠nigha̠ ma̠ a̠rumor na̠ aru̠marani̠ da̠mi̠.
Ami̠ ta̠ amo̠r aso̠r a̠tutumeni nyam d̠a̠ a̠kokod̠ia̠n a̠nwunom bho̠.”

content: O̠lo̠gho̠m i̠se̠ sa̠ i̠na agba ma̠a̠,

content.text: “Eb̠em ologi d̠ami̠ ta̠ aro̠ d̠a̠ A̠zib̠a̠.”
“Ami̠ od̠i ma̠ i̠se̠n na̠ anwi̠i̠ny ya̠ A̠zib̠a̠ a̠nigha̠ ami̠ bho̠.”

content: Ebula̠ agu̠o̠ anwi̠i̠ny ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ i̠ro̠ ma̠ a̠nwunom ya̠ inwuna̠ ma̠ asi̠ na̠ ipulupul bho̠, sa̠ A̠zizo̠s a̠ten o̠ni̠ ola̠ asi̠ na̠ ipulupul. I̠na a̠gir o̠ku̠a ma̠ o̠wo̠l d̠a̠ omugh d̠o̠yo̠ o̠pi̠e̠gi̠ a̠limon ta̠ Eru bho̠, wa̠ na̠ a̠sibh a̠limon omugh bho̠.
Ogir o̠ko̠no̠n a̠d̠ighi kisa̠ i̠na a̠rue a̠tenemeni ma̠ ogbo ya̠, d̠a̠ eb̠la̠ a̠ghud̠um d̠awa, i̠ro̠ ma̠ igoni d̠a̠ ebula̠ i̠ku̠nu̠ omugh bho̠.
Ya̠gia̠ga̠i i̠na na̠ alo̠gh agu̠o̠ na̠ a̠nigha̠ ma̠ anwi̠i̠ny a̠rughun ta̠ Ebraham, ya̠a̠ itileduom ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ d̠o̠.

Ebula̠ o̠ku̠a, sa̠ u̠le̠m i̠na u̠gu̠b̠e̠ni̠ ma̠ a̠rumor na̠ aru̠marani̠ d̠o̠yo̠ d̠a̠ eb̠la̠ re̠kal, b̠o̠ka̠ i̠na a̠bhin d̠a̠ igbirigbir na̠ iya̠ igielake̠ aro̠ ma̠ We̠mu̠ Okur d̠i̠yar d̠a̠ a̠misigh ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠. Sa̠ na̠ a̠d̠ighi ma̠ ola̠ a̠nwunom bho̠ na̠ e̠te̠i̠ itulugia̠n na̠ okpon i̠karabh o̠si̠ghe̠ a̠d̠ien.
I̠se̠n i̠na na̠ a̠rue na̠ alo̠gh agu̠o̠ na̠ a̠nigha̠ ma̠ ogbo ya̠ ad̠agi̠an i̠te̠i̠, ezin bho̠ i̠na na̠ agu̠o̠ a̠gbika̠ sa̠ ad̠agi̠an i̠te̠i̠ i̠na nyen.
